hook: First images of the impact of DART asteroid deflection experiment
hookText: First images of the impact of DART asteroid deflection experiment

beats.say: ESA's Hera mission has returned the first close-up images of the crater left by NASA's DART asteroid-deflection test, showing the chaotic aftermath of the cosmic smashup.
The first-of-its-kind experiment worked beautifully as the solar-powered space probe slammed into asteroid Dimorphos, permanently altering its trajectory.

The spacecraft released some 10 billion joules of energy as it impacted Dimorphos in September 2022 at more than 13,700 mph, shortening the asteroid’s 12-hour orbit around Didymos by about 33 minutes.
